doc: LEADERBOARD_PRD.md §3, §4, §6 — one entry per board. The three boards score different data and are never mixed in one table. `frozen` hashes are stamped when the first real row lands (M4); a board whose hashes are still TODO refuses every `add`.

main.label: Main
main.subtitle: P2 — genome-wide
main.rows_note: CANDI versions, retrained rivals, naive baselines.

strict_view.note: Rescored on P2 minus chr19. CANDI is then fully position-out-of-sample while position-transductive rivals keep their advantage — CANDI's strict number is conservative by construction (PRD §4).

caveats: CANDI trained on chr19 positions only, so on the default view CANDI is position-in-sample on chr19 and position-out-of-sample on the other 22 chromosomes.

Position-transductive rivals (Avocado, ChromImpute) train on every genomic position by construction — they are position-in-sample everywhere, on both views. No choice of eval chromosome removes this asymmetry; it is disclosed, badged on every row, and bounded by the strict toggle.

dev.label: Dev
dev.subtitle: P1 — chr21
dev.rows_note: Same rows as Main; the fast board new CANDI versions hit first.
caveats: Development board — chr21 only. Numbers here select what goes to the Main board; they are not the headline result.
CANDI trained on chr19, so it is position-out-of-sample on chr21; position-transductive rivals are position-in-sample here too.

entrants.label: Entrants
entrants.subtitle: Dataset-3 — EIC blind test
entrants.rows_note: The 23 EIC entrant submissions + CANDI + baselines.
caveats: Dataset-3 truth is the signal the 2019 challenge distributed — a different quantity from the Dataset-2 stores the internal boards score. Scores never translate between the two (RIVALS_PLAN.md, Max's 005: 12-66% per-experiment error for that move).
DNase-seq is excluded from every Dataset-3 row (B3): in Dataset 2 it is read-depth normalized signal, a different physical quantity.
Entrant rows are the submissions as frozen in 2019, not retrained; CUImpute1, CUWA and ICU submitted identical predictions and count once, not three times.
